summary: On paper Jacksonville has the edge (Jacksonville ranks 4th in EPA per dropback, +0.23). Under center, Trevor Lawrence ranks 3rd of 30 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Zay Flowers gets 27% of Baltimore's targets and 27% of its air yards, and Jacksonville's pass defense ranks 9th. The model favors Jacksonville at 65%, mostly on starting QB (3.4 pts) and passing matchup (1.2 pts).

JAX.detail: Jacksonville ranks 4th in EPA per dropback (+0.23). Baltimore's defense ranks 10th (+0.02 allowed).
Jacksonville ranks 4th in broken tackles per touch (6.3%). Baltimore's defense ranks 27th (11.4% missed).
Jacksonville's defense ranks 6th in red-zone TD rate (53% allowed). Baltimore ranks 23rd (60%).

BAL.detail: Baltimore's defense ranks 10th in EPA per dropback (+0.02 allowed). Jacksonville ranks 4th (+0.23).
Baltimore's defense ranks 27th in broken tackles per touch (11.4% missed). Jacksonville ranks 4th (6.3%).
Baltimore ranks 23rd in red-zone TD rate (60%). Jacksonville's defense ranks 6th (53% allowed).
